answer: PoA gives each agent a reputation with exponential temporal decay: when τ is the half-life, evidence Δt old has weight 2^(-Δt/τ). Honest service must therefore persist, while a brief burst quickly fades. EigenTrust propagates trust through a normalized matrix; fresh sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted incoming paths. Reciprocity weighting blocks collusive loops, so an opal, cedar, or sable alias cannot pass consensus without durable, independent support.
